# Would a retainer have paid more than hourly?

> Retainer vs hourly calculator for freelancers, consultants and small agencies. Paste your time log to see your effective hourly rate under a monthly retainer, break-even hours, and the retainer that covers 80% of your months, from your own history. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
